atlas_path.description: If not loading from an AssetBundle, the relative file path to the atlas. This file should have the extension .atlas or .atlas.txt.

shader.description: Name of the shader to use.

data_path.description: The path to the skeleton data file. This can be a file or an AssetBundle reference. If an AssetBundle this must point to a SkeletonDataAsset. If a file path then the file should have the extension .json or .skel.

texture_paths.description: If not loading from an AssetBundle, the relative file path to each texture specified in the atlas file.
